name: OpenLauncher
description: OpenLauncher is a fast, modern, and open-source Minecraft launcher built with React and Tauri with Rust
author: CesarGarza55

scripts.build:win:installer: npx tauri build --no-bundle && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('release/win-unpacked', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('src-tauri/target/release/openlauncher.exe', 'release/win-unpacked/OpenLauncher.exe');" && cd script && "C:\Program Files (x86)\NSIS\makensis.exe" installer.nsi && cd ..
scripts.build:win:portable: npx tauri build --no-bundle && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('release', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('src-tauri/target/release/openlauncher.exe', 'release/OpenLauncher-Portable-Windows.exe');"
